Telo.Application/SourceEntriesInvalidApp: source 'addon' entry 'native/b.node': 'member' must not be empty.
Telo.Application/SourceEntriesInvalidApp: source 'addon' entry 'native/c.node': sha256 must be 64 lowercase hex characters — run `telo release stage --pin` to write it.
Telo.Application/SourceEntriesInvalidApp: source 'addon' entry 'native/d.node': a pin is sha256 and executable together — run `telo release stage --pin` to write both.
Telo.Application/SourceEntriesInvalidApp: source 'addon' entry 'native/e.node': an entry is either a link (target) or a file (upstream, member, sha256, executable) — remove 'upstream' or 'target'.

Telo.Application/SourceEntriesInvalidApp: source 'addon' entry 'native/a.node/inner': path 'native/a.node/inner' runs through 'native/a.node' as a directory, and source 'addon' entry 'native/a.node' produces 'native/a.node'. A staged path cannot be both a file and a directory — give each entry its own path.
